final: WITH region_stats AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, AVG(t.amount) AS avg_amount, COUNT(*) AS transaction_count FROM trans AS t JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id GROUP BY d.A3), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(avg_amount) AS cross_region_avg FROM region_stats) SELECT AVG(r.avg_amount) AS average_transaction_amount, AVG(r.transaction_count) AS average_transaction_count, AVG(r.avg_amount - b.cross_region_avg) AS average_above_cross_region_average FROM region_stats AS r CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE r.avg_amount > b.cross_region_avg
